rawCommits.subject: fix(scrollbar): round overlay thumb and grow it in the hit area
rawCommits.body:
The overlay scrollbar thumb used a padding + content-box clip trick that only rounded its outer edge, leaving an oddly shaped flat inner edge, and never changed width. Render the visible bar as a rounded ::after pill inside a transparent 12px hit area, and animate it wider on hover/drag.

rawCommits.subject: fix(projects): update task checkmarks in real-time during dev runs
rawCommits.body:
Dev automation completes tasks via `transition_task`, which emits a
`task_updated` status edge rather than the harness `task_completed`
event. The Tasks-tab list hook (`useTaskListData`) already consumed this
edge, but it only subscribes while the Tasks tab is mounted. The
always-mounted `useProjectLayoutData` patched the layout cache for the
lifecycle events but ignored `task_updated`, so `initialTasks` went
stale whenever the user watched the Run tab during a run -- the checkmark
only corrected itself after a manual refresh/refetch.

Subscribe to `task_updated` in `useProjectLayoutData` and patch the
layout cache so the Tasks tab reflects completed tasks on its next mount
regardless of the active sidekick tab. Extract the shared `isTaskStatus`
guard into `task-display-status` so both hooks validate the wire status
identically.

Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>
rawCommits.cleanSubject: update task checkmarks in real-time during dev runs

rawCommits.subject: fix(public-chat): re-mint guest token on 401 so chat self-heals
rawCommits.body:
Cached guest tokens are signed with GUEST_JWT_SECRET; a server-side
secret change on deploy left every visitor's persisted token failing
verification with "invalid guest token", and the recovery action
invalidateToken() was never wired up, so desktop and mobile chat were
permanently stuck.

Detect a guest-auth rejection (401 / "guest token" message) via the new
isGuestAuthError predicate, discard the stale token, re-mint a fresh one,
and silently retry the same turn once. Applied to PublicChatView,
MobilePublicChatView, and the dispatch-media boundary (opt-in via reauth).

Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>
rawCommits.cleanSubject: re-mint guest token on 401 so chat self-heals

rawCommits.subject: fix(projects-sidebar): stop dev-run executor agents piling up via local ledger
rawCommits.body:
Each ad-hoc dev/automation task run mints a fresh ephemeral Executor
project_agents row, tagged instance_role=executor + source=system. The
existing sidebar filter and startup janitor both rely on aura-storage
echoing those columns on list_project_agents, but when storage strips
them the rows default to chat + null source: the client filter shows
them and the role-based purge cannot find the orphans. A dev server
restart mid-run kills the in-memory reaper, so every run leaves a
permanent duplicate "Summarize This Me" row.

Add a storage-independent ledger of system-minted (Loop/Executor)
instance IDs persisted in SettingsStore:
- record on create_instance_from_agent_with_role, forget on delete
- purge_executor_instances_in_project drains the ledger by ID first
  (reclaims orphans even when storage stripped instance_role), keeping
  the role scan as a secondary pass
- list_agent_instances excludes ledger-tracked IDs so infrastructure
  rows never render regardless of what storage returns

Pre-existing orphans created before this change carry no ledger entry
and are not auto-removed.

Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>
rawCommits.cleanSubject: stop dev-run executor agents piling up via local ledger

rawCommits.subject: feat(media-placeholder): animate loading dot grid with canvas ripple
rawCommits.body:
Replace the static CSS panning dot-grid in the image/video generation placeholder with a canvas where individual dots pulse in radius and brightness in flowing ripple waves, so the wait reads as actively working. Respects prefers-reduced-motion by drawing a single static frame, and guards getContext for jsdom test environments.

Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>
rawCommits.cleanSubject: animate loading dot grid with canvas ripple

rawCommits.subject: fix(chat): fade generated images in after decode
rawCommits.body:
Generated chat images mounted a bare img element the moment the
generation stream completed, so the bitmap painted in progressively and
the frame grew downward while it downloaded. Gate FadeInImage reveal on
img.decode() and add GeneratedImageFrame, which keeps a loader in a
reserved square box until the image is fully decoded, then fades it in.

Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>
rawCommits.cleanSubject: fade generated images in after decode

rawCommits.subject: fix(ci): make setup-node resilient to transient DNS failures
rawCommits.body:
Wrap actions/setup-node in a local ./.github/actions/setup-node composite that polls api.github.com and nodejs.org with backoff before installing, so a transient 'getaddrinfo ENOTFOUND' blip on the self-hosted runners no longer fails the build-sidecar job on the first attempt. Centralizes the pinned Node version and migrates all first-party workflow usages.

Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>
rawCommits.cleanSubject: make setup-node resilient to transient DNS failures

rawCommits.subject: fix(ci): use upstream setup-node in subdirectory-checkout jobs
rawCommits.body:
The publish-manifests and changelog jobs check out the repo into subdirectories (repo/workflow/pages) rather than the workspace root, so the local ./.github/actions/setup-node composite cannot be resolved there ('Can't find action.yml ...'). These jobs all run on GitHub-hosted ubuntu-latest runners that never had the self-hosted DNS issue, so revert just those five steps to actions/setup-node@v5.

Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>
rawCommits.cleanSubject: use upstream setup-node in subdirectory-checkout jobs

rawCommits.subject: fix(changelog): count all summary stats up to their real values
rawCommits.body:
The two release stats never animated and the commit stats snapped in on cached revisits (initial state was seeded to the target) and ramped to a fake 1000 placeholder on cold load. Simplify useCountUp to always start at 0 and ease directly to the real target, and wire it into both release stats so all four numbers count up on every visit.

Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>
rawCommits.cleanSubject: count all summary stats up to their real values

Expose a quality dropdown (low/medium/high/auto) in Image mode for GPT
Image models and thread the choice from the chat UI through
aura-os-server to aura-router so OpenAI receives it. Defaults to medium
so generations are faster than the previous always-high behavior; the

rawCommits.subject: feat(chat): add Session Cost section to context popover
rawCommits.body:
Add a "Session Cost" section beneath the (now-labeled) "Context
Composition" breakdown in the bottom-bar Context popover. It shows the
model, cumulative input/output/total tokens, a weighted "Avg. Cost per
Token" with a per-type rate overlay (input/output/cached), and the total
billed token cost in dollars (1 Z = $0.01).

Pricing uses base provider rates plus the 20% markup that aura-router
applies, so figures match what is actually debited. The backend
context-usage endpoint now surfaces cumulative tokens, cache totals,
model, and provider (extracted into a shared context_usage submodule
with one parser reused by the agent and task variants) so the section
survives a page reload instead of waiting for the next assistant turn.

rendered.title: Smarter model picker, session cost visibility, and self-healing public chat
rendered.intro: Today's nightly leans heavily into chat control surfaces: a redesigned model picker with credit multipliers and per-model reasoning effort, a new Session Cost breakdown in the Context popover, and selectable GPT Image quality. Public chat now recovers automatically from stale guest tokens, generated images settle in cleanly, and the marketing site's product page gains live mobile chat mockups. A pair of CI fixes also hardens release builds against transient DNS failures.

entries.title: Public chat recovery, model picker controls, and product page mockups
entries.summary: A dense late-night batch reshaped the public chat experience, the model picker, and the marketing product page.

items.text: Public chat now self-heals after a server-side guest-secret rotation: a new isGuestAuthError predicate catches 401s and "guest token" rejections, discards the stale cached token, mints a fresh one, and silently retries the turn across desktop, mobile, and the dispatch-media boundary.

The chat model picker gained a credit-multiplier badge per model and a hover flyout to pick reasoning effort (Low through Max) for supported models, with the choice persisted per model and forwarded as reasoning_effort on every chat stream request.

Task checkmarks now update live during dev runs — useProjectLayoutData subscribes to task_updated edges and patches the layout cache, so completions appear immediately whether the user is on the Tasks tab or the Run tab.

Marketing /product page replaced empty PhoneShell placeholders with three looping mobile chat mockups driven by the landing hero's typewriter and terminal-stream primitives, and the public chat transcript, sidebar nav, hero video fade, and overlay scrollbar all got targeted visual fixes.

entries.title: Executor agent ledger stops dev-run sidebar pileup
entries.summary: A persistent local ledger now tracks system-minted Executor instances so they can be reclaimed even when storage drops their role metadata.

items.text: Ephemeral Executor agents spawned by dev/automation runs no longer pile up as duplicate "Summarize This Me" rows in the projects sidebar: a SettingsStore-backed ledger records every system-minted instance ID on creation, drives the purge by ID so orphans are reclaimed even when aura-storage strips instance_role, and hides ledger-tracked rows from list_agent_instances regardless of what storage returns.

entries.title: Calmer media generation: ripple loader and decoded image fade-in
entries.summary: The image generation experience now feels deliberate from placeholder to final frame.

items.text: The image and video generation placeholder swapped its static CSS dot grid for a canvas where dots pulse in flowing ripple waves, so the wait reads as actively working; prefers-reduced-motion still draws a single static frame.

Generated chat images no longer paint in progressively or grow their frame downward — a new GeneratedImageFrame reserves a square box with a loader, gates the reveal on img.decode(), and fades the finished image in.

entries.title: Hardened setup-node against runner DNS blips
entries.summary: A local composite action now polls the Node and GitHub registries with backoff before installing, with a targeted carve-out for jobs that check out into subdirectories.

items.text: All first-party workflows now use a local ./.github/actions/setup-node composite that polls api.github.com and nodejs.org with backoff before invoking actions/setup-node, so a transient getaddrinfo ENOTFOUND on self-hosted runners no longer kills build-sidecar on the first attempt; the pinned Node version is centralized in one place.

The publish-manifests and changelog jobs, which check the repo out into subdirectories on GitHub-hosted runners, were reverted to upstream actions/setup-node@v5 so the composite's path resolution doesn't break them.

entries.title: Session Cost popover, image quality picker, and provider-grouped models
entries.summary: A morning of chat-surface work added cost visibility, image quality control, a restructured model picker, and supporting polish on the marketing site.

items.text: The bottom-bar Context popover now includes a Session Cost section showing the active model, cumulative input/output/cached tokens, a weighted average cost per token with a per-type rate overlay, and the total billed cost in dollars — using aura-router's 20% markup so figures match what's actually debited, and hydrating from the backend on reload.

GPT Image models gained a quality dropdown (low/medium/high/auto) wired from the chat UI through aura-os-server to aura-router, now defaulting to medium for faster generations and persisting per agent; DALL·E and Gemini keep provider defaults and hide the control.

The chat model picker was reorganized into collapsible Anthropic / OpenAI / Open Source sections via a shared ModelMenuGroup component reused by desktop and mobile, surfacing Kimi K2.6 and adding Anthropic Haiku 4.5 to the visible list.

Marketing polish: the Changelog page's four summary stats now always animate from zero to their real values on every visit, and the Feedback page gained an animated submitted/resolved/participant banner computed from an unfiltered fetch so it stays stable as list filters change.

highlights: Model picker grouped by provider with credit multipliers and reasoning-effort control
New Session Cost section breaks down tokens and dollars per chat
Public chat self-heals after guest-token secret rotations
GPT Image gains a low/medium/high/auto quality selector
Self-hosted CI runners ride out DNS blips on setup-node
